form_controls.attributes: id="displayName" name="displayName" [(ngModel)]="displayName" #display="ngModel" required maxlength="100" autocomplete="nickname" [attr.aria-invalid]="display.invalid && display.touched" /

id="username" name="username" [(ngModel)]="username" #handle="ngModel" required minlength="3" maxlength="50" pattern="[a-zA-Z0-9_.\-]+" autocomplete="username" aria-describedby="username-hint" [attr.aria-invalid]="handle.invalid && handle.touched" /

id="email" name="email" type="email" [(ngModel)]="email" #emailInput="ngModel" (input)="syncAutofilledEmailControl(emailInput)" (change)="syncAutofilledEmailControl(emailInput)" (blur)="syncAutofilledEmailControl(emailInput)" required email maxlength="254" autocomplete="email" [attr.aria-invalid]="emailInput.invalid && emailInput.touched" /

id="password" name="password" [type]="showPassword ? 'text' : 'password'" [(ngModel)]="password" #passwordInput="ngModel" required [minlength]="mode() === 'login' ? 1 : 10" maxlength="128" [pattern]="mode() === 'login' ? '.*' : '(?=.*[a-z])(?=.*[A-Z])(?=.*[0-9]).{10,128}'" [autocomplete]="mode() === 'login' ? 'current-password' : 'new-password'" [attr.aria-describedby]="mode() === 'login' ? null : 'password-hint'" [attr.aria-invalid]="passwordInput.invalid && passwordInput.touched" /
id="resendEmail" name="resendEmail" type="email" [(ngModel)]="email" required email autocomplete="email" /
id="channelName" type="text" class="text-input" [(ngModel)]="name" name="name" [placeholder]="'channel.namePlaceholder' | translate" [disabled]="busy()" required /

id="channelHandle"
              type="text"
              class="text-input handle-field"
              [(ngModel)]="handle"
              name="handle"
              (input)="onHandleInput($event)"
              (ngModelChange)="onHandleInput($event)"
              (compositionend)="onHandleInput($event)"
              (blur)="onHandleBlur($event)"
              [placeholder]="'channel.handlePlaceholder' | translate"
              [disabled]="busy()"
              autocomplete="off"
              spellcheck="false"
              required
            /
id="inviteEmail" name="inviteEmail" type="email" class="text-input" [(ngModel)]="inviteEmail" required [disabled]="busy()" [placeholder]="'channel.memberEmailPlaceholder' | translate" /
[id]="'reply-' + row.comment.commentId" name="reply" [(ngModel)]="replyText" [placeholder]="'studio.replyPlaceholder' | translate" rows="2" required maxlength="2000"
id="video-title" name="title" class="text-field title-field" [(ngModel)]="title" maxlength="100" required /
id="video-description" name="description" class="text-field description-field" [(ngModel)]="description" maxlength="5000" [placeholder]="'studioEdit.descriptionPlaceholder' | translate"

id="video-tags" name="newTag" class="edit-tag-input" type="text" [(ngModel)]="newTag" maxlength="80"
              [placeholder]="'upload.step2.tagsPlaceholder' | translate"
              [disabled]="tags().length

class="text-field" type="text" [name]="'videoCardTime-' + card.id" inputmode="numeric" placeholder="0:00" [class.is-invalid]="!isVideoCardValid(card.id)" [ngModel]="card.time" (ngModelChange)="updateVideoCardTime(card.id, $event)" [attr.aria-label]="'upload.step3.bannerTime' | translate" [disabled]="saving()" /

id="newTag" type="text" class="tag-input" [(ngModel)]="newTag" name="newTag"
                       [placeholder]="'upload.step2.tagsPlaceholder' | translate"
                       (keydown.enter)="$event.preventDefault(); addTag()" /
class="player-volume" type="range" min="0" max="1" step="0.05" [value]="volume()" (input)="setVolume($any($event.target).value)" [attr.aria-label]="'watch.volume' | translate" /
id="displayName" name="displayName" [(ngModel)]="displayName" #display="ngModel" required maxlength="100" autocomplete="nickname" [attr.aria-invalid]="display.invalid && display.touched" /

id="username" name="username" [(ngModel)]="username" #handle="ngModel" required minlength="3" maxlength="50" pattern="[a-zA-Z0-9_.\-]+" autocomplete="username" aria-describedby="username-hint" [attr.aria-invalid]="handle.invalid && handle.touched" /

id="email" name="email" type="email" [(ngModel)]="email" #emailInput="ngModel" (input)="syncAutofilledEmailControl(emailInput)" (change)="syncAutofilledEmailControl(emailInput)" (blur)="syncAutofilledEmailControl(emailInput)" required email maxlength="254" autocomplete="email" [attr.aria-invalid]="emailInput.invalid && emailInput.touched" /

id="password" name="password" [type]="showPassword ? 'text' : 'password'" [(ngModel)]="password" #passwordInput="ngModel" required [minlength]="mode() === 'login' ? 1 : 10" maxlength="128" [pattern]="mode() === 'login' ? '.*' : '(?=.*[a-z])(?=.*[A-Z])(?=.*[0-9]).{10,128}'" [autocomplete]="mode() === 'login' ? 'current-password' : 'new-password'" [attr.aria-describedby]="mode() === 'login' ? null : 'password-hint'" [attr.aria-invalid]="passwordInput.invalid && passwordInput.touched" /
id="confirmPassword" name="confirmPassword" type="password" [(ngModel)]="confirmPassword" required maxlength="128" autocomplete="new-password" /
id="resendEmail" name="resendEmail" type="email" [(ngModel)]="email" required email autocomplete="email" /

type="checkbox" [checked]="selectedReports()[report.reportId] || false" (change)="toggleReport(report.reportId, $any($event.target).checked)" [attr.aria-label]="'reports.selectReporterReport' | translate:{ name: report.reporterName || ('reports.user' | translate) }" /

type="text"
              class="modal-input"
              required
              maxlength="200"
              [disabled]="editLoading() || busy()" [ngModel]="editTitle()"
              (ngModelChange)="editTitle.set($event)"
              name="title"
            /

type="text"
              class="modal-input"
              required
              minlength="3"
              [placeholder]="'videos.changeMetadataPlaceholder' | translate"
              [disabled]="editLoading() || busy()" [ngModel]="editReason()"
              (ngModelChange)="editReason.set($event)"
              name="reason"
            /
